title: 18258 - 18258/P1850
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri Harness issue
stepByStepSolution: Inspect wiring and terminals for CAN BUS between Kontrol Modülüs.
technicalNotes: As per TSB 01-07-54, do not Değiştirin / Yenileyin: the ECM for this DTC.  Please see TSB for complete details.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
